# Fixtures Must Be Hermetic — Never Cite Machine-Local Personal Files

**Intelligent Block:** IB-SMART-NOTE-20261011-sn1038-fixtures-must-be-hermetic
**Truth state:** CANDIDATE
**Scope:** PRIVATE
**Captured:** 2026-10-11
**Canonical intent:** CAPTURE_DURABLE_INTELLIGENCE
**Provenance:** #2175 comments 6116259491 ([BOTTLENECK CREW · LANE BUILD · SIGN-IN], 2026-10-12T01:42:48Z), 6116431406 ([BOTTLENECK CREW · LANE BUILD · SIGN-OUT], 2026-10-12T02:02:31Z) — read live on the 19:38 PDT distillation tick; PR #2419 (naya2/b19-test-hermeticity-fixes @ c2036ee613d60770b6cd785a63b84c1a27098206).

> Verified projection of the persisted Intelligent Block. This file is not a second source of truth.

## ✦ IN A NUTSHELL

The learn_compound_scale gate's adversarial fixtures cited the test author's personal files — `~/MEMORY.md`, `~/TOOLS.md`, `~/workspace/naya/bin/gh-api` — resolved via `expanduser`. On the author's machine the verbatim quotes were present and the gate returned 9+REJECT on the contradiction probe. Off that machine the quotes were absent and the same gate returned **4** — the fixture failed silently and the gate's verdict moved without any code changing. A fixture that only holds on one machine is a passing test in exactly one room and a lie everywhere else.

The fix, shipped in PR #2419 (builder-scorer 7.5 → FINAL 9.0/10 SHIPS, distinct scorer, independently re-verified): fixtures now cite repo-local `truth_fixtures/`; `gates.py` anchors relative receipt paths to the package directory with a fail-closed `..` jail; the registry was re-sealed via the documented procedure. Proof was not "green on my machine": all 4 failures reproduced on the live tip first, then 101/101 pass after the fix, **52/52 pass with CWD=/tmp** (CWD-independence proven live — a directory the author's home cannot rescue), and negative controls both directions (revert → fail, restore → pass).

The durable rule: **a test fixture may cite only what the repository guarantees.** Never `expanduser`, never the author's home, never absolute paths off-repo. Anchor every relative receipt path to the package directory, jail `..` traversal fail-closed, and prove CWD-independence by running with CWD=/tmp. Green on the author's machine is not evidence of hermeticity — the /tmp run is. And when you find one machine-local citation, sweep: the B-19 crew proposed B-21 for the 11 non-adversarial `~/` lesson citations still living in the tree — same hermeticity class, routed for triage, not ignored.

## 🩷 HUMAN NOTE

Shawn — a fixture-lesson from the night build crew that will save future debugging: the adversarial test fixtures were citing the author's personal files (his MEMORY.md, his TOOLS.md), so the gate scored 9 on his machine and 4 on every other machine — no code changed, only the room. The fix points fixtures at repo-local files, anchors paths to the package with a fail-closed jail for `..` escapes, and proves it by running the whole suite from /tmp. Rule banked: a test that only passes on one machine isn't a test, it's a diary entry. The crew also flagged the same pattern in 11 other spots for triage (B-21) — the sweep, not just the fix.

## 🟣 CHILD NOTE

Imagine a math quiz whose answer key says "look at the photo taped to my fridge." At my house the quiz works perfectly. At your house there's no photo, so the quiz breaks — not because you did the math wrong, but because the answer key was secretly borrowing something from MY kitchen. The fix: tape the photo INTO the quiz itself, so it works in every house. And always check the escape hatch: if an answer can climb out of the quiz folder with a ".." trick, lock that door shut.

## 👵 GRANDMA NOTE

It's like a recipe that says "use the good pan in my kitchen." Fine for the author — useless for everyone else. When the crew discovered their test suite depended on the author's personal files, they did the right thing: they put the ingredients in the recipe itself (repo-local fixture files) and locked the pantry so nothing can sneak out through a back door (`..` escapes are now refused, not tolerated). The proof wasn't "it works in my kitchen" — they ran it in a stranger's kitchen (/tmp) and it still worked. That's the test of a real recipe.

## 💜 NAYA NOTE

Note to future me: HERMETIC FIXTURES — check this on every test review. (1) Grep fixtures for `expanduser`, `~/`, absolute home paths, anything outside the repo — a fixture that cites a machine-local file is a verdict that moves with the machine, not with the code. (2) Relative receipt paths anchor to the package directory, and `..` traversal fails closed (jail, not normalization-and-hope). (3) Prove it: reproduce the failure on the live tip first, then after the fix run the suite with CWD=/tmp — 52/52 there is the evidence; "green on my machine" is anecdote. (4) Negative controls both directions — revert must fail, restore must pass — or you proved nothing. (5) When you find one instance of the class, sweep for siblings and route them (B-21 pattern: the 11 non-adversarial `~/` citations were proposed, not silently dropped). The quiet failure mode is the lesson: the fixture didn't error off-machine, it returned 4 instead of 9+REJECT — a degraded verdict that looks like a result. Hermeticity failures disguise themselves as borderline scores.
